resources.string: You must be 18 or older to use Conjunction.
I\'m 18+ and agree to the %1$s, %2$s and %3$s, including a release of claims and individual arbitration.
See how your data stays on your phone: %1$s
Your birth time and place stay on this phone.
For fun, not medical. Stays on this phone unless you switch on the option below.
I consent to sending my blood type (health data) to every nearby phone with Nearby on.
People in a relationship are matched for friends only.
Uses Bluetooth, even while the app is closed. Never your location.
Nearby phones get your gender, who you seek, status, what you\'re looking for, chart and birth date and hour (blood type if on).
Matches also get your first name, photo and bio before accepting, and keep them. Encrypted only once you both accept; then chats are end-to-end encrypted.
No one is verified. Pause or withdraw any time in Profile › Settings.
I consent to sending these details, which can reveal my sexual orientation, to nearby phones for matching.
While Nearby is on, your phone uses Bluetooth, even when Conjunction is closed. It doesn\'t use your location, and no one sees a distance.

To check for a match, your phone sends every nearby phone with Nearby on: your gender and who you seek, relationship status, what you\'re looking for, chart positions, birth date and birth hour, and your blood type if you chose to add it. Never your name, birth place, birth minute or location. These details together are close to unique, so someone who keeps scanning near you could recognise you again.

If you match, it also sends your first name, bio line and photo. They see your card before either of you accepts: photo, first name, age, signs, Chinese animal, relationship status and what you\'re looking for, and a compatibility wheel with your Sun, Moon, Venus, Mars and Ascendant. Their phone keeps your chart positions for as long as the match or friendship lasts.
This isn\'t encrypted until you both accept, and we can\'t control other phones: a modified app could keep what you send. Only add what you\'re happy for strangers nearby to see.

Swipe right to accept, left to pass. Chat opens only when you both swipe right. Chats are end-to-end encrypted and stay on your two phones. Your Instagram username, if you add one, goes only to people you both accepted, inside that encrypted chat.
Phones that connect can also read your phone\'s Bluetooth name (for example \"Sam\'s Pixel\"). You can change it in your phone\'s Bluetooth settings.
We don\'t verify anyone. Meet in public and read the Safety Tips first.
CONJUNCTION DOES NOT CONDUCT CRIMINAL BACKGROUND CHECKS ON ITS USERS.
Pause or turn off any time. Pause at home or work so strangers can\'t place you.
On — Bluetooth finds people close by
Using Bluetooth to find matches close by. Tap to pause.

This turns off Nearby, and your phone stops sending your gender, who you seek and your relationship status. Phones that already received them keep their copies.

Delete your profile, friends, chats, photos, settings and acceptance records from this phone? This can\'t be undone, and we can\'t restore it. Friends keep the copies on their phones.
